answer: Require every agent to earn trust through a long, verifiable voyage of completed work: each job leaves a signed receipt that others can check, so reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. A newcomer starts on a flat mesa of zero standing and must do real, checked tasks before handling valuable work. An attacker trying to forge many identities would need to pay the full time and effort cost for each one, making a Sybil flood expensive and slow.
